name: L1 Norm Regularization for Transfer Functions
aliases: L1 Regularization on Opacity and Color TFs
definition: L1 norm regularization is applied to both opacity and color transfer functions to avoid unnecessary complexity when a simpler TF yields a similar result.
summary: L1 Norm Regularization for Transfer Functions applies an L1 penalty to opacity and color parameters to prevent overfitting and produce simpler, more intuitive transfer functions than methods constraining internal network features.
